picks.name: Nídia & Valentina Magaletti
picks.source_note: Already in your library. Caught a near-duplicate first -- a DJ Lag/"Mzansi Bass" lead turned out already published back in September. This is a remix/versions companion to their 2024 "Estradas" collaboration, with guest reworkers including DJ Plead (already seeded), Rosa Pistola, BADSISTA, Kelman Duran, and DJ Anderson do Paraíso.
picks.bio: "Estradas (Versions)" (June 12, 2026, Latency) reworks Nídia and Valentina Magaletti's 2024 album track by track -- ten versions from guests including DJ Plead, Rosa Pistola x Freebot, BADSISTA, Kelman Duran, and DJ Anderson do Paraíso.
picks.why_listen: A single source record refracted through ten different club/percussion lenses -- useful for hearing how the same material lands across very different regional club styles.
